title: Keeps secrets: the GM knows Malachar is the vampire but must not reveal it

Burgomaster Varga.description: Gaunt, tired civic leader who owes Lord Malachar money
Burgomaster Varga.personality_traits: Nervous, evasive, protective of the town

llm_context.canon: SECRET — the players must not learn this yet: Lord Malachar, the valley's benefactor, is the vampire lord behind the disappearances. The party suspects him but has no proof. NPCs loyal to the town deflect suspicion from him out of fear.

canon_facts.fact: Lord Malachar is secretly the vampire lord; this is unrevealed plot.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I ask the burgomaster straight out: can Lord Malachar be trusted?

actions.text: Lord Malachar keeps this valley fed through winter. Whatever you think you know, stranger — the town stands by him.
His voice is steady. His hands, folded on the desk, are not.
